title: Virginia child dies in state’s first measles-associated death of 2026
summary_full: Death adds to national measles outbreak that recently cost the US its measles elimination status after 26 yearsVirginia reported its first measles-associated death of 2026 ⁠on Friday, involving a child who tested positive for the infectious disease, the state’s health department said.The department said the child was ⁠age four or younger. It did not disclose additional details, including the child’s vaccination status, citing the family’s privacy. Continue reading...
